Outstanding Craftsmanship and Attention to Detail!

We couldn’t be happier with the work this company did rebuilding our outdoor veranda. From start to finish, their professionalism and craftsmanship were top-notch. The structure is not only solid and beautifully built, but the decorative details they added truly make it stand out. Very happy with our experience working with Decathlon. It is fair to say the best experience we’ve had with contractors to date. They built a patio cover that truly feels like an addition to our home. Each crew that came to work on our home was professional, timely, respectful and talented at their trade. April was very easy to communicate with when needed, and prompt in providing weekly agendas. Highly recommend.

Decathlon is a family-owned and operated local business. They recently built a large, beautiful carport over our garage entrance that matches our existing property appointments.  They are absolutely the best contractor we’ve ever worked with.  They handled every detail, from drawing up a design concept with quote options, laying out the construction details, filing for permits, managing the time frame and subcontractors, all the way to the final inspection.  It was a much better experience than

We are so pleased with our experience with Decathlon Construction! Our completed patio has added so much to our home. We love entertaining family and friends outside. They are always complimenting our new patio and the excellent construction. Everyone we dealt with throughout the project was very skilled and helpful. Decathlon does a great job of communicating throughout  and helping us get the most out of our budget. We highly recommend Decathlon Construction!

Decathlon added a porch/outdoor living space and did an amazing job. They sent weekly emails detailing work to be done that week. From their carpentry team, concrete, electrical, gutter subs; every aspect was top notch.

They did beautiful work and did not cut corners. The communication was excellent throughout the whole process.

I highly recommend Decathlon for a porch install. I couldn’t be more pleased.

I have been enjoying my patio cover since September of 2022. Decathlon is a top notch contractor. Jerry the owner met with me and went over several options and gave me a detailed estimate including breakdown pricing on all the options. He was very professional and on time. We had gotten quotes from several companies for a patio cover and decathlon gave us the biggest bang for our buck.

They were easy to work with, communicated well, and the final project was great!

Definitely would recommend!

Jerry and April were great.  Jerry's crew exceeded my expectations every day they came to work.  The attention to detail was really something.  I now have a really nice space that looks great and makes me and my family happy.  Thanks again to all the folks at Decathlon

They were in constant communication with us throughout the process and we are definitely happy with our new patio cover!

For additional items and customizations they were very accommodating with design and cost estimates.  Very responsive to my questions and quick to resolve any issues.  We are very satisfied with the new living space.  Highly recommend that you consider building with Decathlon.

We selected Decathlon in a thorough bidding process.  We liked the recommendations and they submitted a competitive bid for our pergola and patio extension projects. Amazing work and quality. Great team at Decathlon, communication was great and vision of what is possible, gave us great ideas to make the best decisions. Super happy with them and especially our patio and outside kitchen. Now we have an extra room and can enjoy being outside in the Texas heat. Thanks Decathlon

Decathlon Construction and their team did an awesome job with my patio project.  Everyone was very professional and provided quality service.  They answered all of my questions and kept me updated on everything.  Very impressive.  I highly recommend this company.  I appreciate all of their work and effort.

Decathlon Construction built our patio cover. Terry and April were very professional and quick to respond to questions. I was impressed with all of their crews that worked on our project. I would not hesitate to recommend them to anyone.

We were referred by friends who had a great experience and they did not disappoint!  We had a great experience as well. April and Jerry were very responsive and addressed any questions we had along the way.  We had our back porch totally redone and it’s like a whole new living and dining space. We absolutely love it!!

I cannot say enough good things about Jerry and his team at Decathlon Construction. They installed a concrete patio and installed 3 new doors in my house, including a set of french doors where a wall used to be. Jerry helped me decide what to build that was within my budget and then his crew was absolutely amazing implementing it. They showed up when they said they would and got the work done quickly. They communicated consistently, were clear on the project, and delivered on time and on budget. The construction itself was all top notch! I highly recommend them!

The quality of work is first class all around and their quality of service and responsiveness to questions or changes along the way was exceptional. They were extremely responsive, knowledgable and engaging when it came to the planning part of the process.  Listening to what our vision was, while making recommendations based on their expertise.

Over the course of the project, we were always kept up to spee

Decathlon Construction is a 1st rate organization.
The workmanship and materials are the best. Terry and April are a great help and will guide you through the entire project.
They can build anything you want and it will be magnificent and worth every penny. Your new addition will last a lifetime.

It was great doing business with Decathlon Construction. I found them to be a good value while still providing a quality product. There was no over-sale. He had great images of similar patio/house combinations so I could visualize the final product. In fact, the final product looked even better than what we had
Decathlon Construction built a covered patio on my house. They did an awesome job and were so easy to work with! I am very satisfied with all aspects of the project.

Hello, I'm not one to write reviews typically though I wanted to share my experience. Jerry and Team completed a patio cover and stamped concrete project a few years ago. The job was done on-time, on budget, with great communication from his Team along the way. No complaints, I only wish we would have added a fire place and outdoor grill at the time! that's on me. Jerry and April Terry, owners of Decathlon Construction,  have completed two patio covers, a fence, a concrete walkway, and a deck for us over the years.  Every project was completed quickly, on schedule,  very professionally, and at a reasonable price.  The results always look amazing! Their crews are always very respectful of our property, and leave the site very clean when they're finished.  I recommend Decathlon Construction without any reservations.

We have worked with Decathlon Construction for both of our backyard projects. Several of our neighbors have contracted with them after seeing our first covered deck seven years ago. Last year we decided to extend the roof to cover the entire deck and tie it all in to the house. We called Jerry and April again because we knew the work would be the highest quality. Again they exceeded our expectations! Every person who worked on our project was polite, thoughtful and skilled. The best and most imp

I don’t leave many reviews but I had to with this great company. As a civil engineer and being around construction for 20+ years, this company takes pride in their work as the materials they use is top notch, communication with April is great, and the attention to detail is wonderful. I have seen other covered patios in my subdivision as they don’t look nearly as nice. Covered patios can be pricey but it was all worth it. Highly recommended.

April and Jerry Terry of Decathlon Construction are top notch!! Decathlon created and built an amazing outdoor space for us! The scheduling of all phases of construction was perfectly smooth and communicated very well. Attention was spot on! Crews were courteous, clean and impeccable craftsmanship! We have had many other construction projects over the years with other contractors- those projects were laden with many difficulties. We had none of those issues with Decathlon! You will not be disapp

Decathlon is very professional. They came up with a beautiful patio design, then went above and beyond throughout the process. We are so happy with our patio. It transformed our backyard into a usable fun space for our family.  April and Jerry are truly awesome at what they do. Best contractor we have ever used!

Decathlon Construction is a very professional operation from their first visit to learn about your desires and providing an estimate to the construction and completion and clean up.  Jerry was very helpful in developing our vision for our patio cover and April was there to answer questions as well as keeping us updated on the building schedule.  We could not be happier with our new patio cover or the experience of working with Decathlon Construction.

Our experience with Decathlon was exceptional!  They added on a cedar patio cover and we couldn't be happier.  The experience was positive from the get go and continued until the very end. April was a pleasure to work with as well as the all the contractors. We HIGHLY recommend Decathlon!!!

Decathlon Construction did a great job on our additional living space, just under 400sqft plus large patio! Everything from demo, to installation, to clean up went very smoothly. The owners Jerry & April were very attentive, while our foreman Orsin and his crew were very professional and worked hard. Everyone mentioned did an excellent job to ensure they built the space we wanted and we couldn’t be happier!

Highly recommend.

I recently had the opportunity to engage with this company during my search for the right team to handle my patio project. From the outset, they were thoroughly professional and incredibly helpful. They promptly addressed all my questions and provided a detailed consultation on-site, which I found very informative.I must commend this company for their exceptional customer service. Their dedication to their craft and potential clients is evident, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend their service

Decathlon Construction is above par when it comes to outdoor living space design and customer service. Our beautiful living space was complete in Spring 2019 and it took a reasonable amount of time from start to finish. Everything was choreographed strategically and we were always in the loop on time frames and construction details for each day.

They have a construction crew for each specialty, for example: a masonry team, concrete team, wood stain team, electrical team, trim team, gutter team,

Decathlon Construction designed and built our covered patio and outdoor kitchen.  The addition was beautifully designed and well built.  Jerry and April had excellent communication throughout the project.  A+ service and we will use them again in the future.

This is the second time we have used Decathlon Construction.  The team did a complete remodel of our backyard.  Work Included an outdoor kitchen, new covered patio, fire pit, arbor and stamped concrete.  They performed excellent work!  I would highly recommend Decathlon Construction.

Decathlon was professional throughout our construction.  The site was kept clean on a daily basis.  All contractors were very kind and efficient. All our questions were answered promptly.  I would recommend April and Jerry to anyone wanting to improve their backyard experience.

Jerry, April - you built me a backyard patio 10+ years back in Allen. I just wanted to say the patio you built for us is still getting kudos from our friends and they say it is the best they have seen. We have been enjoying it so much as well. I thought you would want to hear this so sharing. Keep up your great service.

In light of all the construction horror stories I heard regarding costs, labor shortages, and delays, I was hesitant to begin our patio project.

However, from beginning to end, April and Jerry responded efficiently and professionally with any questions, requests, or follow ups we had.

The quality of the project ended with an excellent result and within the estimated finish date. The fees associated with the project were reasonable, and any potential changes were addressed prior to the start da

If there was a 6 star rating, I would absolutely give it for this company.  I cannot say enough about how amazing these folks are.  This was my 3rd patio I had them install over the years.  From the initial measurement and quote to the finishing touches with gutters and paint - every single person that we interacted with was professional, clean, detail oriented and just plain awesome.  The price, service and follow up have always been top notch.  Keep doing what you are doing, Jerry and April!
Decathlon is extremely professional and the quality of their work is superb!  They are great at communicating with you throughout the process.  We strongly recommend Decathlon Construction.

We love our new outdoor space! We had several companies come out and tell us because of our roof line and eaves on our house we couldn't have a solid covered patio. We were told we would have to have a pergola on half the space. Not only did Decathlon do exactly what we wanted they exceeded our expectations. It is absolutely beautiful! We couldn't be more pleased.

My outdoor area had a unique situation and I had no idea what could be done to build what I wanted. When I gave the task to Decathlon Construction, they came up with a creative design that was more than I could imagine. The results were beyond my expectations and I was completely satisfied with the finished product.  I recommend them highly.
